mechanism: Actual producer adoption can change only assumed provider finalization effort/capacity; no automatic demand, price, quality or review uplift.
economic_identification: Conditional parameter regions; exact human effort, construction/inference total, demand, WTP, quality and collections are not identified by existing experiments.
production: Existing six-transition three-arm frozen comparison; any separately registered new tuples remain separately identified.
stress_scenarios: All named scenarios exported by src/market.mjs, same 24 seeds, all three arms; no favorable-only scenario selection.
adoption_only: Prospective-operator grid plus same-seed reference/low-demand/cheap-AI/slow-collection stress scenarios; original research is explicitly sunk and historical repayment forbidden.
historical_timing: Primary full-history cost accrues at opening from equal finite seed and may cause insolvency; operating surplus can fund later adoption only. At-adoption full historical allocation is separately labeled retrospective sensitivity, not evidence of original R&D affordability.
adoption_delay: At least one week and ceil(adoptionHours/engineeringHoursPerWeek), with enterprise deliveries paused; source becomes active only at availability week.
stochastic_pairing: Seed+semantic key draws; arm names excluded. B/C economic and outcome summaries must be exactly equal under matched effects and costs.
inference: Paired sample mean and percentile of seed differences; 95% normal-approximation Monte Carlo interval 1.96*sample_sd/sqrt(n). It summarizes worlds under assumptions, not uncertainty in market identification.
recording: Every run exports exact config, outcomes, invoices, bills, cash payments, balances, buyer actions, investment decisions and competition; original failed runs retained.
freeze_rule: Source/protocol/scenario hashes and UTC timestamp must be recorded before primary outcomes are inspected.
